# Purpose

The purpose of `app.R` is to create a simple Shiny web application. The application displays a heading, text, an image, and an interactive slider.

# Inputs

The application uses a slider input called `my_slider`. The user can select a number from 10 to 100, with a default value of 50.

# Outputs

The script produces a Shiny web page containing text, an image, and an interactive slider. A basic server function is included so the application can run.

# Code Example

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(shiny)

ui <- fluidPage(
  h1("First Shiny Website"),
  p("I am excited to learn ", strong("Shiny"), "!"),
  sliderInput("slider", "Pick a number:", min = 10, max = 100, value = 50)
)

server <- function(input, output) {
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
